lines:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Author
  participant API as MCP or Desktop
  participant Store as Shared ProjectStore
  participant Backend as Selected Storage Adapter
  participant Projection
  participant Files as Generated Markdown
  Author->>API: Retrieve document
  API->>Store: Consistent snapshot
  Store->>Backend: Read canonical body and token
  Backend-->>Author: Complete document and readToken
  Author->>API: Save merged content with token and operationId
  API->>Store: Typed guarded mutation
  Store->>Backend: Validate references and token atomically
  alt Current token
    Backend-->>API: Committed identity and fresh token
    API-->>Author: Save succeeded
    Projection->>Store: Read committed snapshot
    Projection->>Files: Refresh full documents and short links
  else Stale token
    Backend-->>API: Current document and fresh token
    API-->>Author: Conflict with no stored changes
  end

data.title: Canonical Markdown authoring and generated discovery
